args: $health = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/health; $receipts = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/receipts; Write-Output ('health: ' + $health.StatusCode + ' ' + $health.Content); Write-Output ('receipts: ' + $receipts.StatusCode + ' ' + $receipts.Content)
